purpose: Canonical contract joining Shine Core, Shine ID and Shine Vault while preserving standalone operation of every Shine application.

universeRole.applicationRelationship: Shine applications are independent appendages that may connect to Foundation for shared Universe capabilities.

modes.requirement: The application performs its primary purpose without Foundation availability.
The application may use Shine ID, Core or Vault services without transferring ownership of its primary local function.
The application may participate in authorised cross-app experiences through Core.

nonResponsibilities: becoming mandatory for an app's primary standalone purpose
using user-editable profile metadata as authorisation authority
granting access merely because an app is a Shine app
exposing an entire user's resource set when only one category is required

app.notes: An app declares what it may request; declaration alone never grants access.

subject.notes: Authentication-provider identifiers may map to shineId but are not the cross-Universe primary key.

resource.notes: The resource catalogue describes protected resources without requiring apps to know Vault storage internals.

permissionRequest.notes: Permission is purpose-bound and scoped to the minimum resource/category necessary.

accessDecision.notes: Every decision is explicit and auditable.

invariants: A registered Shine app has zero private Vault access until a matching grant exists.
Revocation must prevent future authorised reads after revocation takes effect.
A denied Foundation request must not disable the application's unrelated standalone capability.
Cross-app data movement must be mediated by Core and constrained by the user's grants.
Shine AI may propose or coordinate an action but does not override ID, Vault or Defence authorisation.
